```{r}
phylo_cpn60 <- readRDS("cpn60/filtered.rds")
filtered_cpn60 <- prune_samples(sample_data(phylo_cpn60)$control == "sample", phylo_cpn60)
filtered_cpn60 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(filtered_cpn60) > 0, filtered_cpn60)

unfiltered_cpn60 <- readRDS("cpn60/unfiltered.rds")
unfiltered_cpn60 <- prune_samples(sample_data(unfiltered_cpn60)$control == "sample", unfiltered_cpn60)

phylo_16s <- readRDS("16S/filtered_silva.rds")
filtered_16s <- prune_samples(sample_data(phylo_16s)$control == "sample", phylo_16s)
filtered_16s <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(filtered_16s) > 0, filtered_16s)

unfiltered_16S <- readRDS("16S/unfiltered_silva.rds")
unfiltered_16S <- prune_samples(sample_data(unfiltered_16S)$control == "sample", unfiltered_16S)
```

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)

ps_species <- tax_glom(filtered_16s, "species")
ps_genus   <- tax_glom(filtered_16s, "genus")

species_level_genera <- c("Lactobacillus", "Gardnerella", "Atopobium", "Sneathia", "Prevotella")

tax_sp  <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_species))
otu_sp  <- apply(otu_table(ps_species), 2, as.numeric)
rownames(otu_sp) <- rownames(otu_table(ps_species))

tax_sp$valencia_name <- mapply(function(genus, species) {
  if (is.na(genus)) return(NA)
  if (!genus %in% species_level_genera) return(NA)  
  if (genus == "Prevotella") return("g_Prevotella")  
  if (!is.na(species)) return(gsub(" ", "_", trimws(species)))
  return(NA)
}, tax_sp$genus, tax_sp$species)

keep_sp <- !is.na(tax_sp$valencia_name)
otu_sp_sub <- otu_sp[, keep_sp, drop = FALSE]
colnames(otu_sp_sub) <- tax_sp$valencia_name[keep_sp]

otu_sp_agg <- as.data.frame(t(rowsum(t(otu_sp_sub), group = colnames(otu_sp_sub))))

cat("Species-level taxa:\n")
print(colnames(otu_sp_agg))

tax_gn  <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_genus))
otu_gn  <- apply(otu_table(ps_genus), 2, as.numeric)
rownames(otu_gn) <- rownames(otu_table(ps_genus))

tax_gn$valencia_name <- mapply(function(genus) {
  if (is.na(genus)) return(NA)
  if (genus %in% species_level_genera) return(NA)  
  return(paste0("g_", genus))
}, tax_gn$genus)

keep_gn <- !is.na(tax_gn$valencia_name)
otu_gn_sub <- otu_gn[, keep_gn, drop = FALSE]
colnames(otu_gn_sub) <- tax_gn$valencia_name[keep_gn]

# 
otu_gn_agg <- as.data.frame(t(rowsum(t(otu_gn_sub), group = colnames(otu_gn_sub))))

cat("Genus-level taxa:\n")
print(colnames(otu_gn_agg))


otu_sp_agg <- otu_sp_agg[order(rownames(otu_sp_agg)), ]
otu_gn_agg <- otu_gn_agg[order(rownames(otu_gn_agg)), ]

otu_combined <- cbind(otu_sp_agg, otu_gn_agg)

cat("\nFinal dimensions:", nrow(otu_combined), "samples x", ncol(otu_combined), "taxa\n")

key_taxa <- c("Lactobacillus_crispatus", "Lactobacillus_iners",
              "Gardnerella_vaginalis", "Sneathia_amnii",
              "Atopobium_vaginae", "g_Prevotella")

cat("\nKey taxa found:\n")
print(intersect(key_taxa, colnames(otu_combined)))
cat("\nKey taxa missing:\n")
print(setdiff(key_taxa, colnames(otu_combined)))

otu_export <- tibble::rownames_to_column(otu_combined, var = "sampleID")
otu_export <- dplyr::mutate(otu_export, 
                             read_count = rowSums(otu_combined), 
                             .after = "sampleID")

write.csv(otu_export, "VALENCIA/valencia_input_16s.csv", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

valencia_out <- read.csv("VALENCIA/valencia_output_16s.csv")  # adjust filename if different

metadata <- as.data.frame(sample_data(filtered_16s)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sampleID")

df <- valencia_out %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sampleID") %>%
  mutate(
    pct_status = case_when(
      grepl("^\\+", pct) ~ "PCT+",
      grepl("^-",   pct) ~ "PCT-",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    subCST = factor(subCST, levels = c(
      "I-A", "I-B",
      "II",
      "III-A", "III-B",
      "IV-A", "IV-B",
      "IV-C0", "IV-C1", "IV-C2", "IV-C3", "IV-C4",
      "V"
    ))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pct_status))

cst_colors <- c(
  "I-A"    = "#2166ac",
  "I-B"    = "#6baed6",
  "II"     = "#74c476",
  "III-A"  = "#fd8d3c",
  "III-B"  = "#fdbe85",
  "IV-A"   = "#d94801",
  "IV-B"   = "#a50f15",
  "IV-C0"  = "#7a0177",
  "IV-C1"  = "#ae017e",
  "IV-C2"  = "#dd3497",
  "IV-C3"  = "#f768a1",
  "IV-C4"  = "#fbb4b9",
  "V"      = "#238b45"
)

p1 <- df %>%
  count(pct_status, subCST) %>%
  group_by(pct_status) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pct_status, y = prop, fill = subCST)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cst_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Vaginal CST Distribution by PCT Status",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of samples",
    fill = "Sub-CST"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
  )

p2 <- df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pct_status, y = score, color = subCST)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cst_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "VALENCIA Similarity Scores by PCT Status",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cosine similarity to centroid",
    color = "Sub-CST"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

summary_tbl <- df %>%
  count(pct_status, subCST) %>%
  group_by(pct_status) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    pct   = round(100 * n / total, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(pct_status, subCST)

print(summary_tbl)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(cst_broad = case_when(
    grepl("^I",   subCST) & !grepl("^IV", subCST) ~ "L. crispatus\n(CST I)",
    grepl("^II$", subCST)                          ~ "L. gasseri\n(CST II)",
    grepl("^III", subCST)                          ~ "L. iners\n(CST III)",
    grepl("^IV",  subCST)                          ~ "Low Lactobacillus\n(CST IV)",
    grepl("^V",   subCST)                          ~ "L. jensenii\n(CST V)"
  ))

p3 <- df %>%
  count(pct_status, cst_broad) %>%
  group_by(pct_status) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pct_status, y = prop, fill = cst_broad)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, "\n(", round(prop*100), "%)")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    title = "Broad CST Architecture by PCT Status",
    x = NULL, y = "Proportion", fill = "CST Group"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

print(p1)
print(p2)
print(p3)
```

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(microViz)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)

cst_meta <- valencia_out %>% 
  select(sampleID, subCST, CST, score)

sample_data(filtered_16s)$subCST <- cst_meta$subCST[match(
  sample_names(filtered_16s), cst_meta$sampleID)]
sample_data(filtered_16s)$CST <- cst_meta$CST[match(
  sample_names(filtered_16s), cst_meta$sampleID)]
sample_data(filtered_16s)$valencia_score <- cst_meta$score[match(
  sample_names(filtered_16s), cst_meta$sampleID)]

ps_ord <- filtered_16s %>%
  tax_fix(unknowns = c("Clostridiales_bacterium")) %>%
  tax_transform("identity", rank = "species") %>%
  tax_transform("clr", chain = TRUE)

ord_ait <- ordinate(ps_ord, method = "PCoA", distance = "euclidean")

plot_data <- data.frame(
  MDS1     = ord_ait$vectors[, 1],
  MDS2     = ord_ait$vectors[, 2],
  sampleID = sample_names(ps_ord)
) %>%
  left_join(
    data.frame(sample_data(filtered_16s)) %>% 
      tibble::rownames_to_column("sampleID"),
    by = "sampleID"
  )

cst_labels <- c(
  "I-A"   = "CST I-A: L. crispatus",
  "I-B"   = "CST I-B: L. crispatus",
  "II"    = "CST II: L. gasseri",
  "III-A" = "CST III-A: L. iners",
  "III-B" = "CST III-B: L. iners )",
  "IV-A"  = "CST IV-A: BVAB1 + G. vaginalis",
  "IV-B"  = "CST IV-B: G. vaginalis + A. vaginae",
  "IV-C0" = "CST IV-C0: Prevotella spp.",
  "IV-C1" = "CST IV-C1: Streptococcus spp.",
  "IV-C2" = "CST IV-C2: Enterococcus spp.",
  "IV-C3" = "CST IV-C3: Bifidobacterium spp.",
  "IV-C4" = "CST IV-C4: Staphylococcus spp.",
  "V"     = "CST V: L. jensenii"
)

pct_centroids <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(pct) %>%
  summarise(MDS1 = mean(MDS1, na.rm = TRUE),
            MDS2 = mean(MDS2, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

cst_centroids <- plot_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(subCST)) %>%
  group_by(subCST) %>%
  summarise(MDS1 = mean(MDS1, na.rm = TRUE),
            MDS2 = mean(MDS2, na.rm = TRUE),
            n    = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(cst_labels[subCST]))

var_exp    <- ord_ait$values$Relative_eig * 100
axis1_label <- paste0("PCoA 1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)")
axis2_label <- paste0("PCoA 2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)")

cst_colors <- c(
  "I-A"   = "#2166ac", "I-B"   = "#6baed6",
  "II"    = "#74c476",
  "III-A" = "#fd8d3c", "III-B" = "#fdbe85",
  "IV-A"  = "#d94801", "IV-B"  = "#a50f15",
  "IV-C0" = "#7a0177", "IV-C1" = "#ae017e",
  "IV-C2" = "#dd3497", "IV-C3" = "#f768a1",
  "IV-C4" = "#fbb4b9", "V"     = "#238b45"
)

cst_colors_labeled <- setNames(
  cst_colors[names(cst_labels)],
  cst_labels
)

p_valencia_ord <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = pct_centroids,
             aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2, fill = pct),
             size = 6, shape = 21) +
  geom_point(data = cst_centroids,
             aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2),
             size = 4, shape = 17, alpha = 0.9, color = "blue") +
  geom_text_repel(data = cst_centroids,
                  aes(x = MDS1, y = MDS2, label = label),
                  color = "blue", size = 2.8,
                  box.padding = 0.4, max.overlaps = 20) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cst_colors_labeled, name = "VALENCIA subCST") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "-PCT_1" = "#1b9e77",
    "+PCT_1" = "#d95f02",
    "+PCT_2" = "#7570b3",
    "No PCT" = "grey"),
    name = "PCT status") +
  labs(
    title = "16S",
    x = axis1_label,
    y = axis2_label
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "vertical")


print(p_valencia_ord)
```
